name: floorplan
description: Keeps an Angular or Spring Boot codebase in shape with Claude: a structure map Claude reads for every task, rules for where code lives and what may use what (built-in, presets, and your own CLAUDE.md rules as warnings), clear issues with file, line and how to fix, a bubble graph to move files, classes and packages with imports rewritten, and a CI check that fails only on new issues.
